title: Sum of Elements With Frequency Divisible by K
summary: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, return the sum of all elements in nums whose frequency is divisible by k, or 0 if no such elements exist.
statement: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, return the sum of all elements in nums whose frequency is divisible by k, or 0 if no such elements exist. Each element is included in the sum as many times as it appears in the array if its frequency is divisible by k.
constraints: Count each distinct value in nums.
Include every occurrence of a value when that value’s frequency is divisible by k.
Return the resulting sum, or zero if no frequency qualifies.
hints: Scan original occurrences, not only distinct keys.
Include an occurrence exactly when its table count has zero remainder modulo k.
This naturally multiplies each qualifying value by its frequency.
editorial: This naturally multiplies each qualifying value by its frequency.

tests.explanation: Twos and threes have divisible frequencies; all their occurrences sum to sixteen.
Every frequency is one, so return zero.
